command: import pathlib,subprocess,sys; fs=[str(p) for p in pathlib.Path(".").rglob("*.go") if ".artifacts" not in p.parts]; r=subprocess.run(["gofmt","-l",*fs],capture_output=True,text=True); print(r.stdout,end=""); print(r.stderr,end="",file=sys.stderr); print("Go files checked:",len(fs)); sys.exit(r.returncode or bool(r.stdout))
